wippy.description: Render the KickSide Memory module-owned Wippy surface inside a host application. Load it by its registered custom-element tag, pass only the documented properties when selecting or editing a resource, and listen for its typed events when the host must navigate, refresh, or accept a value. The component uses the injected Wippy proxy for authenticated APIs and remains isolated inside its Shadow DOM.
